scenicChapters.title: Garden Kingdom of Dessau-Wörlitz → Palace Mosigkau
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 26 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-garden-kingdom-of-dessau-worlitz-.story: A 298 km round trip from Wörlitz - roughly 5 h 08 in the saddle. On the way it passes Palace Mosigkau, Luther's birthplace, Collegiate Church and back through Luther's birthplace. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
